changes: original_meaning 按古英语 trēġ 的 gloss 收为「带低边的平板木盘」。
semantic_path 第二站 how 按 Etymonline 所引 OED 口径（从泛指浅口容器到专指带边平板）替换套话，并点明与 tree 同根。
evidence: Etymonline: "tray (n.) Middle English trei, \"shallow, open vessel or rimmed, flat board,\" for household use, carrying food, dishes, etc.; from Old English treg, trig \"flat wooden board with a low rim,\" from Proto-Germanic *traujam... from PIE *drou-, variant of root *deru- \"be firm, solid, steadfast,\" with specialized senses \"wood, tree\""

Etymonline: "The original sense of the Germanic word might have been \"wooden vessel.\" ... \"Formerly more widely applied to shallow open vessels generally\" (OED); later applied to flat rimmed boards for other than household purposes."
Oxford: "from the Germanic base of tree; the primary sense may have been 'wooden container'."
tray.mechanism_sentence: tray 与 tree 同根（都是「木头」的亲戚）：古英语 trēġ 是带矮边的木头平板，供端食物、盛器皿——材料后来换了金属与塑料，「浅盘、带边」的样子一千年没变。

semantic_path.how: 所指先宽后正：从前 tray 泛指各类浅口敞口容器，后来专定在『带边的平板盘』上（Etymonline 引 OED）——家居之外（实验室、打印机纸盘）也沿用这个形状。词库今义『托盘』即此。

changes: original_meaning 保留拉丁语 tubus 的 gloss「管子，管道」（该拉丁词本身来源不明，已在本条 changes 注明，不伪造谱系）。
semantic_path 按 Etymonline 编年重建三站（1590 年代体内管道 → 1650 年代泛指管筒 → 1900 年前后伦敦地铁）。
mechanism_sentence 重写（原句为罗列式）。
evidence: Etymonline: "tube (n.) 1590s, in anatomy and zoology, \"hollow organ or passage in the body;\" by 1650s as \"pipe or hollow cylinder,\" especially a small one used as a conduit for liquids, from French tube (15c.), from Latin tubus \"tube, pipe,\" a word of unknown origin."

Etymonline: "Tube for \"cylindrical railway tunnel\" is attested from 1847; the London subway was christened the Twopenny Tube by 1900... tube (n.) \"TV as a medium,\" by 1959, from tube as short for cathode ray tube or picture tube."
tube.mechanism_sentence: tube 是拉丁语 tubus「管子」（这个拉丁词再往上来源不明）：从身体里的管道，到实验室的玻璃管，再到能跑火车的大管子——伦敦地铁干脆就叫 the Tube。

semantic_path.how: 1590 年代入英语时先作解剖学词——『体内的中空器官、通道』；1650 年代扩到一切中空圆筒形的管——词库今义『管子』即此。
形状不变、个头可变：1847 年起 tube 指圆筒形铁路隧道，1900 年前后伦敦地铁得了 the Tube 的浑名；1959 年电视机也因显像管被叫 tube——都是『一根管子』认的亲。

changes: original_meaning 大改：现行字段写「管子，管道」，那是 1540 年代才在英语里发展出的义；最早的实义按 Etymonline/牛津改为漏斗形捕鸟网与烟道，并溯其『大桶』小号 tonel 的来路。
semantic_path 第二站 how 按编年（1540 年代管子义 → 1660 年代隧道义 → 1878 年法语反借）写明。
evidence: Etymonline: "tunnel (n.) early 15c., tonnel, tonel, \"funnel-shaped wire net into which birds were decoyed,\" from Old French tonel, tonnelle \"net,\" diminutive of Old French tonne \"tun, cask for liquids\""

Etymonline: "The meaning \"tube, pipe\" (1540s) developed in English and led to the sense of \"underground passage, passage or (later) railway road under the bed of a stream, through a mountain, etc.\" (1660s). This sense subsequently has been borrowed into French (1878)."
Oxford: "late Middle English (in the senses 'tunnel-shaped net' and 'flue of a chimney'): from Old French tonel, diminutive of tonne 'cask'."
tunnel.mechanism_sentence: tunnel 的老底是「大酒桶」（tonne）的缩小版：先是桶形的捕鸟网和烟囱烟道，1540 年代成了泛指的「管子」，1660 年代管子钻进地里、穿过山——隧道诞生；后来法语又把这个新义从英语借了回去。

semantic_path.how: 形状引路：桶形的网、桶形的烟道都是『中空的筒』——1540 年代英语 tunnel 泛指管子、管道，1660 年代落成『地下的通道、穿山越河的隧道』（词库今义）；1878 年法语把这个成熟的新义从英语反借了回去。

changes: original_meaning 前溯到中世纪拉丁语 universitas 的 gloss「整体；团体」，并在 how 里写明学术义是长短语 universitas magistrorum et scholarium 的缩略——现行字段直接以学府义为原义，掩盖了『先有人团、后有学府』的关键一层。
semantic_path 第二站 how 按 Etymonline 编年（约 1300 年团体与学府两义并存）替换套话。
evidence: Etymonline: "university (n.) c. 1300, universite, \"institution of higher learning,\" granting license to teach and other higher degrees; also \"body of scholars and other persons associated for the purpose of study,\" from Anglo-French université, Old French universite \"universality; academic community\" (13c.), from Medieval Latin universitatem (nominative universitas), \"the whole, aggregate,\" in Late Latin \"corporation, society,\" from universus \"whole, entire\""
Etymonline: "In the academic sense, it represents a shortening of universitas magistrorum et scholarium \"community of masters and scholars\""
Oxford: "from Latin universitas 'the whole', in late Latin 'society, guild', from universus 'combined into one, whole', from uni- 'one' + versus 'turned'."
university.mechanism_sentence: university 的拉丁老底 universitas 是「合起来的整体、结成的团体」：中世纪的大学首先是「教师与学者结成的行会」——先有这群人，后有这所学校。

semantic_path.how: 长短语缩略成校名：universitas magistrorum et scholarium 是『教师与学者共同体』；约 1300 年英语 universite 入词时，『构成大学的人员团体』与『高等学府』两义并存——此后指机构、指地方的一面胜出，词库今义『大学』即此。
